question: What is the total literacy rate of Bihar according to the 2011 census of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __61.80%__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• According to the Census of India, 2011 the literacy rate in Bihar is 61.80%.
 
• The male literacy rate in Bihar is 71.20% and the female literacy rate is 51.50%.
 
• It is much lower than the national average which stands at 74.04% in total.
 
• The male literacy rate is 82.14% and female literacy at 65.46% of India.
